name: Corporate Action Amounts 1
definition: Specifies amounts in the framework of a corporate action event.

GrossCashAmount.name: Gross Cash Amount
GrossCashAmount.definition: Amount of money before any deductions and allowances have been made.

NetCashAmount.name: Net Cash Amount
NetCashAmount.definition: Amount of money after deductions and allowances have been made, if any, ie, the total amount +/- charges/fees.

IssueDiscountAmount.name: Issue Discount Amount
IssueDiscountAmount.definition: Amount of money defined as a discount on a new issue or on a tranche of an existing issue.

SolicitationFees.name: Solicitation Fees
SolicitationFees.definition: Amount of cash premium made available in order to encourage participation in the offer. Payment is made to a third party who has solicited an entity to take part in the offer.

CashInLieuOfShare.name: Cash In Lieu Of Share
CashInLieuOfShare.definition: Cash disbursement in lieu of a fractional quantity of, eg, equity.

OriginalAmount.name: Original Amount
OriginalAmount.definition: Amount in its original currency when conversion from/into another currency has occurred.

CapitalGain.name: Capital Gain
CapitalGain.definition: Amount of money distributed as the result of a capital gain.

InterestAmount.name: Interest Amount
InterestAmount.definition: Amount of money representing a coupon payment.

IndemnityAmount.name: Indemnity Amount
IndemnityAmount.definition: (Unique to France) Amount due to a buyer of securities dealt prior to ex date which may be subject to different rate of taxation.

RedemptionPremiumAmount.name: Redemption Premium Amount
RedemptionPremiumAmount.definition: Amount of money (not interest) in addition to the principal at the redemption of a bond.

ManufacturedDividendAmount.name: Manufactured Dividend Amount
ManufacturedDividendAmount.definition: Amount of money that the borrower pays to the lender as a compensation. It does not entitle the lender to reclaim any tax credit and is sometimes treated differently by the local tax authorities of the lender.

PrincipalOrCorpus.name: Principal Or Corpus
PrincipalOrCorpus.definition: Amount of money representing a distribution of a bond's principal, eg, repayment of outstanding debt.

ReinvestmentAmount.name: Reinvestment Amount
ReinvestmentAmount.definition: Amount of money reinvested in additional securities.

MarketClaimAmount.name: Market Claim Amount
MarketClaimAmount.definition: Amount of money resulting from a market claim.

FullyFrankedAmount.name: Fully Franked Amount
FullyFrankedAmount.definition: Amount resulting from a fully franked dividend paid by a company; amount includes tax credit for companies that have made sufficient tax payments during the fiscal period.

UnfrankedAmount.name: Unfranked Amount
UnfrankedAmount.definition: Amount resulting from an unfranked dividend paid by a company; the amount does not include tax credit and is subject to withholding tax.

SundryOrOtherAmount.name: Sundry Or Other Amount
SundryOrOtherAmount.definition: Amount of money related to taxable income that cannot be categorised.

SpecialConcessionAmount.name: Special Concession Amount
SpecialConcessionAmount.definition: Amount of drawdown or other reduction from or in addition to the deal price.

EntitledAmount.name: Entitled Amount
EntitledAmount.definition: Cash amount based on terms of corporate action event and balance of underlying securities, entitled to/from account owner (which may be positive or negative).

CashIncentive.name: Cash Incentive
CashIncentive.definition: Rate of the cash premium made available if the securities holder consents or participates to an event, e.g. consent fees.

AdditionalSubscriptionCost.name: Additional Subscription Cost
AdditionalSubscriptionCost.definition: Additional costs - coming on top of the subscription costs - which the subscriber should pay as per the subscription process. Not to be used for the subscription cost itself.

TaxFreeAmount.name: Tax Free Amount
TaxFreeAmount.definition: Amount of money that has not been subject to taxation.

TaxDeferredAmount.name: Tax Deferred Amount
TaxDeferredAmount.definition: Amount of income eligible for deferred taxation.

GermanLocalTax1Amount.name: German Local Tax 1 Amount
GermanLocalTax1Amount.definition: Local tax (ZAS Anrechnungsbetrag) subject to interest down payment tax (proportion of interest liable for interest down payment tax/interim profit that is not covered by the tax exempt amount).

GermanLocalTax2Amount.name: German Local Tax 2 Amount
GermanLocalTax2Amount.definition: Local tax (ZAS Pflichtige Zinsen) interest liable for interest down payment tax (proportion of gross interest per unit/interim profits that is not covered by the credit in the interest pool).

GermanLocalTax3Amount.name: German Local Tax 3 Amount
GermanLocalTax3Amount.definition: Local tax (Zinstopf) offset interest per unit against tax exempt amount (variation to offset interest per unit in relation to tax exempt amount).

GermanLocalTax4Amount.name: German Local Tax 4 Amount
GermanLocalTax4Amount.definition: Local tax (Ertrag Besitzanteilig) yield liable for interest down payment tax.

TransferTaxAmount.name: Transfer Tax Amount
TransferTaxAmount.definition: Tax levied on a transfer of ownership of financial instrument.

EURetentionTaxAmount.name: EU Retention Tax Amount
EURetentionTaxAmount.definition: Total amount of tax withheld at source in conformance with the EU Savings Directive.

LocalTaxAmount.name: Local Tax Amount
LocalTaxAmount.definition: Amount of tax charged by the jurisdiction in which the financial instrument settles.

CountryNationalFederalTaxAmount.name: Country National Federal Tax Amount
CountryNationalFederalTaxAmount.definition: Amount of country, national or federal tax charged by the jurisdiction in which the account servicer is located.

TaxReclaimAmount.name: Tax Reclaim Amount
TaxReclaimAmount.definition: Amount that was paid in excess of actual tax obligation and was reclaimed.

TaxCreditAmount.name: Tax Credit Amount
TaxCreditAmount.definition: Amount of taxes that have been previously paid in relation to the taxable event.

WithholdingOfForeignTaxAmount.name: Withholding Of Foreign Tax Amount
WithholdingOfForeignTaxAmount.definition: Amount of money withheld by the jurisdiction in which the income was originally paid, for which relief at source and/or reclaim may be possible.

WithholdingOfLocalTaxAmount.name: Withholding Of Local Tax Amount
WithholdingOfLocalTaxAmount.definition: Amount of money withheld by the jurisdiction in which the account owner is located, for which relief at source and/or reclaim may be possible.

AdditionalTaxAmount.name: Additional Tax Amount
AdditionalTaxAmount.definition: Amount of additional taxes that cannot be categorised.

WithholdingTaxAmount.name: Withholding Tax Amount
WithholdingTaxAmount.definition: Amount of a cash distribution that will be withheld by a tax authority.

FiscalStampAmount.name: Fiscal Stamp Amount
FiscalStampAmount.definition: Amount of fiscal tax to apply.

ExecutingBrokerAmount.name: Executing Broker Amount
ExecutingBrokerAmount.definition: Amount of money paid to an executing broker as a commission.

PostageFeeAmount.name: Postage Fee Amount
PostageFeeAmount.definition: Amount of money paid for delivery by regular post mail.

RegulatoryFeesAmount.name: Regulatory Fees Amount
RegulatoryFeesAmount.definition: Amount of money charged by a regulatory authority, eg, Securities and Exchange fees.

ShippingFeesAmount.name: Shipping Fees Amount
ShippingFeesAmount.definition: Amount of money (including insurance) paid for delivery by carrier.

ChargesAmount.name: Charges Amount
ChargesAmount.definition: Amount of money paid for the provision of financial services that cannot be categorised by another qualifier.
